name: Mica
tagline: A quiet surface, colored by your wallpaper.
description: An opaque, softly tinted material inspired by Windows 11 Mica. Only the wallpaper colors the active window; inactive windows return to a neutral light or dark surface.

controls.label: Wallpaper color
controls.description: How much of the wallpaper's color reaches the material. Zero gives a solid neutral surface.
